224:t_1:169.en:
$$ランカ$$
「...I... want to go to those ruins...」

224:t_1:170.en:
$$アルト$$
「Go there...? You... This isn't a picnic, you know?」

224:t_1:171.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Even if it's dangerous, I want to see them too. What people from the distant past left behind to convey something... I want to see it with my own eyes.」

224:t_1:172.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Because I... want to convey something too...」

224:t_1:174.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I'll guard $$ランカ$$. ...I request your permission, Major $$オズマ$$.」

224:t_1:175.en:
$$オズマ$$
「I've heard $$ランカ$$'s wishes. I'm trusting you with her protection, $$ブレラ$$, $$アルト$$.」

224:t_1:183.en:
$$マックス$$
「...That concludes our situation report.」

224:t_1:184.en:
$$ミリア$$
「Learning that $$ミレーヌ$$ is safe is the best thing to come out of this.」

224:t_1:185.en:
$$マックス$$
「I understand how you feel, but the $$バトル７$$'s mission...」

224:t_1:186.en:
$$ミリア$$
「I'll stop mixing personal and official matters now. But after a stroke of luck like that, I can't help being hopeful about exploring the $$ネオ・ラクス$$ ruins too.」

224:t_1:187.en:
$$ミリア$$
「I'll be waiting for good news.」

224:t_1:188.en:
$$マックス$$
「Understood. We'll do our utmost as well.」

224:t_1:189.en:
$$ミリア$$
「And ask $$ミレーヌ$$ for me. Has she made any progress with Captain $$ガムリン$$?」

224:t_1:191.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「...$c should have reached the ruins on Planet $$ネオ・ラクス$$ by now.」

224:t_1:192.en:
$$マックス$$
「Are you sure, Chief of Staff? You had the $$バトル７$$ move because you wanted to see the ruins yourself, yet you're staying here.」

224:t_1:195.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「Perhaps it is my nature as a records officer... I wish to record what happens, rather than take part in the events myself.」

224:t_1:196.en:
$$マックス$$
「And you have a feeling that something will happen?」

224:t_1:197.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「...Looking back, perhaps this feeling began when they appeared before us through that mystery of the universe.」

224:t_1:198.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「No... Before that, I now regret carelessly using the term 'mystery of the universe.'」

224:t_1:199.en:
$$マックス$$
「What do you mean, Chief of Staff?」

224:t_1:200.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「It is all just a feeling...」

224:t_1:201.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「But I believe we will encounter something beyond human understanding in this operation.」

224:t_2:3.en: ～Inside the $$プロトカルチャー$$ Ruins～

224:t_2:4.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「...This is as far as our machines can go. We'll proceed on foot.」

224:t_2:9.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Don't look away from your fear. Hope lies beyond it.」

224:t_2:11.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I fought under 《$$グレイス#keyword$$》 O'Connor's orders to regain my memories of the past...」

224:t_2:12.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「But I learned that what truly matters isn't the memories I lost, but what lies ahead... the future.」

224:t_2:13.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「That's why I could fight. I knew that hope lay beyond fear.」

224:t_2:15.en:
$$セツコ$$
「His words seem to have given you something to think about.」

224:t_2:17.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We've only been apart for two days, but you seem to have grown.」

224:t_2:18.en:
$n
「...Little by little, I feel like I'm beginning to understand your strength and $$ランド$$'s, $$セツコ$$.」

224:t_2:19.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm sure you'll become even stronger, $n.」

224:t_2:20.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Is that a feeling you have?」

224:t_2:23.en:
$$アルト$$
「This is bad! The ceiling's collapsing!」

224:t_3:3.en: ～Inside the $$プロトカルチャー$$ Ruins～

224:t_3:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$$ミレーヌ$$ and Captain $$ガムリン$$ are rescuing $$バサラ$$. I'm sure he'll be all right.」

224:t_3:8.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But it's a dead end. We can't go any farther.」

224:t_3:9.en:
$n
「What do we do? Blow up the door?」

224:t_3:10.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「No... I'm sure this is like the ruins on $$惑星ラクス$$.」

224:t_3:11.en:
$$アルト$$
「So this is one of those sealed doors...」

224:t_3:12.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Come, $$ランカ$$... You must open the door.」

224:t_3:14.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I hear this door reacts to proof of peace... In other words, someone with the blood of different species.」

224:t_3:15.en:
$$アルト$$
「Right...! $$ランカ$$ has $$ゼントラーディ$$ blood...!」

224:t_3:17.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「...I don't know whether that is proof of peace.」

224:t_3:18.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「But, $$ランカ$$... We were born into this world because someone wanted us.」

224:t_3:20.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I'm sure there were all kinds of obstacles. But we're here... We were someone's hope.」

224:t_3:24.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I don't have to just be protected. I can give someone hope too...」
